source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    values = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    overall_bg = max(set(values), key=values.count)
    candidates = []
    for c in range(w):
        col = {grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}
        if len(col) == 1 and next(iter(col)) != overall_bg:
            candidates.append(("v", c))
    for r in range(h):
        row = set(grid[r])
        if len(row) == 1 and next(iter(row)) != overall_bg:
            candidates.append(("h", r))
    orientation, sep = candidates[0]
    if orientation == "v":
        a = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
        b = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
        width = min(len(a[0]), len(b[0]))
        a = [row[:width] for row in a]
        b = [row[:width] for row in b]
    else:
        width = w
        a = grid[:sep]
        b = grid[sep + 1:]
        height = min(len(a), len(b))
        a, b = a[:height], b[:height]
    va = [v for row in a for v in row]
    vb = [v for row in b for v in row]
    bg_a = max(set(va), key=va.count)
    bg_b = max(set(vb), key=vb.count)
    if bg_a == bg_b:
        return [[bg_a if a[r][c] != bg_a or b[r][c] != bg_b else 3
                 for c in range(width)] for r in range(len(a))]
    fg_a = max((v for v in set(va) if v != bg_a), key=lambda v: va.count(v))
    return [[3 if a[r][c] != bg_a and b[r][c] != bg_b else fg_a
             for c in range(width)] for r in range(len(a))]
'''

    va = [v for row in a for v in row]
    vb = [v for row in b for v in row]
    bg_a = max(set(va), key=va.count)
    bg_b = max(set(vb), key=vb.count)
    if bg_a == bg_b:
        return [[bg_a if a[r][c] != bg_a or b[r][c] != bg_b else 3
                 for c in range(width)] for r in range(len(a))]
    fg_a = max((v for v in set(va) if v != bg_a), key=lambda v: va.count(v))
    return [[3 if a[r][c] != bg_a and b[r][c] != bg_b else fg_a
             for c in range(width)] for r in range(len(a))]
